checks: Destination calendar day selected; Edit day is beside its heading; no false drag handle
Confirmed title link, planned-day hours and Full details visible together, including short laptop
Full-details browser return restores selected day, stop and list scroll
Selecting a stop without coordinates never substitutes a different place on the map
Google coordinates follow map selection and retain day/stop when returning to itinerary
Moves show Saving then Saved; Undo uses current server version; locked booking remains fixed
Rejected edit stays unchanged with adjacent explanation; stale response reloads before next save
Tablet/390px/320px sheet: visible details, focus containment, nested notes, Escape and focus/scroll return
Sheet respects reduced motion; 200% text remains horizontally contained
Unknown hours remain unknown; delayed map does not block title, hours or Full details
Closed hours warn; fixture venue is labelled synthetic and has no false canonical place link
Upcoming includes future drafts; search, sort, filter and list scroll survive trip/browser return
All Trips retains mobile dates/status, no overflow, empty-filter recovery and distinct retryable errors

Unverified places remain in Needs you, preserve source hints, and cannot be confirmed or mapped without provider matches
Stale owner sharing preview withholds saved stops and points back to the redesigned itinerary
Planning update is a compact dismissible overlay; the persistent review action explains replacement; cancel and Escape do not write; confirmation uses saved version; reorder targets are 44px
Vertical desktop rail, mobile dock, route state, creation link and keyboard account menu work at desktop, tablet and phone sizes
Shared illustrated covers stay below 280px with magazine navigation above the fold and no editing controls
A tall 600 by 1800 synthetic photo is cropped into the bounded shared cover
No runtime errors or unexpected requests; owner maps avoid OSM tiles; public tiles and all external content intercepted
scope: Offline Chromium; real components/hooks/styles/API client, synthetic data and Google iframe. Native Next navigation, live persistence and live Google rendering are not covered.
